estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands picking a fully ripe red chili pepper from a healthy, leafy pepper plant
Close-up of a man's hands in thin gloves spreading chili pepper seeds on a sheet of paper towel on a wooden tray; the small mascot figurine sits on the edge of the wooden tray
Close-up of a man's hands writing a name and a date with a pen on a small paper seed envelope, dried chili pepper seeds beside it
Chili pepper plant under harsh midday sun on a hot day, fallen flowers on the soil and almost no fruit on the branches
Habanero pepper plant with wrinkled lantern-shaped orange fruits hanging among green leaves
Smooth green jalapeno peppers hanging from the plant, one with fine brown streaks on the skin
Tabasco pepper plant covered with many small upright peppers in yellow, orange and red
Rocoto pepper plant with fuzzy leaves and a red fruit cut open showing black seeds; the small mascot figurine stands on the soil next to the plant
